name: personal-chess-analyzer
description: Personal Chess Analysis Desktop App with Chess.com styling and Stockfish

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "VITE,ELECTRON" -c "blue,green" "vite" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development wait-on tcp:5173 && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development wait-on tcp:5173 && wait-on file:dist-electron/electron/main.js && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: tsx tests/regression.mts && tsx tests/highlights.mts && tsx tests/productFixes.mts && tsx tests/dataPersistence.mts
scripts.start:standalone: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path');const exe=path.resolve('release/PersonalChessAnalyzer-win32-x64/PersonalChessAnalyzer.exe');if(!fs.existsSync(exe)){console.error('Standalone-Build fehlt. Bitte zuerst \"npm run package:win\" ausfuehren.');process.exit(1);}const env={...process.env,NODE_ENV:'production'};delete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE;const res=cp.spawnSync(exe,[],{cwd:path.dirname(exe),stdio:'inherit',env});process.exit(res.status??0);"

author: simonkuhn-eng
